title: cress theme metadata
description: Schema for a cress theme's metadata file (theme.toml): what the theme says about itself, and the template contract it was written against. The file is optional, and so is every field in it.

name.description: Display name of the theme. Cress resolves a theme by its directory under themes/, so this is what people read and never what gets loaded; the two are allowed to differ.

description.description: One-line summary of what the theme is for.

license.description: License the theme is published under, ideally an SPDX identifier such as "MIT".

homepage.description: Where the theme lives, e.g. its repository.

cress.description: The template contract the theme was written against, as a version such as "1.1". A cress older than this may not provide every field the theme reads, and a cress a whole major version newer no longer promises the contract; either way cress warns and still builds the site. Pre-release and build metadata are ignored when comparing.
